observed_value: Flagged extracted identifiers include EdgeEdge Bidco B.V for the Raptor debt row and Raptor equity continuation rows without the Raptor issuer.
anchor_value: Raw source table 8 identifies row 21 as Raptor US Buyer II Corp. first-lien loan and rows 48-57 as Raptor US Buyer II Corp. ordinary share classes; row 58 is the subtotal.

findings.detail: The flagged debt identifier for the $86.364 million par 3/2029 loan carries EdgeEdge Bidco B.V, but the raw source row issuer is Raptor US Buyer II Corp.
The flagged equity identifiers are actual Raptor share-class positions, not schedule totals, but the extracted identifiers omit the carried-forward Raptor issuer and include section headings instead.

findings.detail: The raw source subtotal for the Raptor ordinary share classes is row 58, while the flagged class rows 49-57 are individual positions; PP01's subtotal signature is therefore over-broad for those rows.

rationale: Raw source table 8 localizes the problem. The second flagged debt row is not EdgeEdge Bidco B.V; it is Raptor US Buyer II Corp. at table 8 row 21. The equity class rows are also Raptor continuation rows under row 48, while the actual subtotal is row 58. Thus the flagged set is not simply a false PP01 subtotal alarm: it contains source-grounded identifier extraction defects caused by row-continuation/context carryover. No aggregate anchor was needed.
